title: Development Communication Extension DCE - Lady Irwin College, Delhi
summary: Development Communication Extension DCE - Lady Irwin College, Delhi: The webpage provides information about the Department of Development Communication Extension (DCE) at Lady Irwin College, Delhi. It lists contact details, including the phone number 014836, and indicates the college operates from 9:30 am to 5:00 pm. The site notes that no testimonials are available and offers quick links for students and site visitors. Lady Irwin College is affiliated with the University of Delhi, holds an A+ NAAC accreditation, and ranks 31 in the NIRF rankings.
